From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Turner <jamie.turner@acmeai.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmeai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up / reschedule — Acme AI

Hi Jamie / Sam,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call:

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and latency for customer support embeddings/search.
- Constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data, prefer VPC deployment, expected Q4 rollout to 3 engineering teams.
- Success metrics: <20ms tail latency for short-context search, 40% token cost reduction vs current setup.

You mentioned wanting a technical deep-dive/demo with your infra and security folks. I blocked a few demo/tech-deep-dive slots next week — can you pick one that works and I will send a calendar invite with the SE included?

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 7/15, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed 7/15, 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Thu 7/16, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

If those are tight, please tell me which single slot works and I will lock it. I’ll attach a short demo agenda and the discovery deck for context.

Agenda (attached): 15m discovery recap + 30m technical demo + 15m integration/Q&A.

Attachments: Discovery-Deck-AcmeAI.pdf, Proposed-Agenda.docx

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — sorry about today, we had an overlapping exec incident that pulled our CTO into another call and we couldn’t make the intended time. Really appreciate the recap and the agenda.

All three of your proposed times look reasonable. Two notes:
- Our security lead (Samantha) is only available in the morning windows.
- We prefer that any calendar invite include the SE + a short note on what infra we should have accessible for the demo (e.g., sample S3 access, redacted dataset).

Can we lock Thu 7/16 9:00–10:00 AM PT? If you can confirm explicitly (I’ll get Samantha to accept right after), that would help — we had a no-show this morning so tighter confirmation helps us avoid conflicts.

Thanks,
Jamie
Director of Product — Acme AI

Hi Jamie — Thu 7/16 9:00–10:00 AM PT is locked. I just sent a calendar invite to you and Samantha; please accept when you can.

Notes on the invite: SE (Aditya Rao) is included — he’ll lead the technical demo and will call out the minimal infra access we’ll need (sample S3 signed URL + a sandbox account token). I’ve added the short proposed agenda in the invite description.

Prep items for Acme team:
- A sample S3 bucket with ~500 redacted records (or signed URL)
- A list of the top 3 query types you want to prioritize for latency testing
- A short Slack or email contact (ops lead) we can reach during the demo if we need quick infra access

I’ll sync with you both the morning of the demo to confirm readiness. Looking forward to it.
